title: Tech View Columns menu shows a count, Show all and Reset to default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • [User-B] = "Nora New" (the expected results name her, so keep this name): a brand-new user who has never changed any Work Orders columns, created under Settings > Staff with an Admin role, signed in in this browser for the whole case.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Columns Count" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], led by [Tech-A] so [Tech-A]'s group has a row.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member, enter First Name and Last Name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email. Pick a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), pick at least one Department (required), set Location to this location and turn Time Clock on, then click Save & Close. Record as [Tech-A].
  3. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Columns Count" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Columns Count" and its Asset > Save, and record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close.
  5. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1] = [Tech-A].
  6. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member for "Nora New" with an email you can open, Role "Admin", at least one Department (required), with this location picked in Location, Time Clock off > Save & Close, then accept the invitation and set a password. Sign out and sign in as Nora New for the rest of the case.
  7. Check the setup worked: as Nora New, Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Columns Count shows [WO-1] led by [Tech-A]. If "Nora New" already existed and has changed columns, create a fresh "Nora New" (different email).
custom_steps:
1. As Nora New, open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Columns Count in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  5. Write down every column heading in [Tech-A]'s group.
  6. Click the Column Selection button in the toolbar (tooltip "Column Selection").
  7. Read the menu heading, the count beside it and the two buttons at the bottom of the menu.
  8. Untick one ticked column (e.g. "Created on").
  9. Read the count and the column headings in [Tech-A]'s group.
  10. Click Show all.
  11. Read the count and the column headings.
  12. Click Reset to default.
  13. Read the count, the column headings and the Reset to default button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the menu is headed "Columns" with a count in the form "<ticked> of <offered> shown" (e.g. "10 of 10 shown"), and the bottom of the menu offers "Show all" and "Reset to default". Reset to default is greyed out and cannot be clicked, because Nora has not changed anything yet.
  • Step 9: the count goes down by exactly one (e.g. from "10 of 10 shown" to "9 of 10 shown") and the unticked column disappears from the Tech View rows at once, without reloading the page.
  • Step 11: Show all ticks every column the menu offers, the count reads "<offered> of <offered> shown" (e.g. "10 of 10 shown") and every one of them is a heading in the rows.
  • Step 13: Reset to default puts back exactly the columns written down in step 5 (Tech View's starting columns, the same as List's default columns) and the Reset to default button is greyed out again.
  • Step 7: columns that are always shown (for example Number and Status) are not listed in the menu and stay in the rows whatever is ticked. The design labels and the "<n> of <m> shown" wording come from the design system: write down the words you see, a different label alone is not a fail.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): the Tech View column menu is headed "Column Selection" and lists the columns with ticks, with no count beside the heading and no "Show all" or "Reset to default" buttons. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Blocked (the developer says this part is not in this release) and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If the menu matches the expected results above, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R1, S5-R4, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html) renders its toolbar through the design system bundle _ds/shopview-design-system-fac6efcf…/_ds_bundle.js: the Columns menu (columns-dropdown.jsx, bundle L349-L659) shows the "Columns" heading, "<n> of <m> shown", "Show all" and "Reset to default" (disabled while the default set is shown), and the Work Orders screen hides the always-on columns from it (bundle L11935-L11939, hideLocked). Design crawl 8 Oct, Tech View state 0, Columns click: "Columns | 10 of 10 shown | Show all | Reset to default". Design-only details (count, Show all, Reset to default, greyed state) are cited to the design; the starting set comes from the PRD. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “Tech View has its own optional-column selection, separate from List. Changing columns in Tech View never changes List, and changing columns in List never changes Tech View.”
  • S5-R4: “Until the user changes Tech View’s columns, Tech View shows the current production List default columns.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
